meta.title: LUMINIST
meta.description: Unique translucent crystal-like material which provides excellent durability.
meta.keywords: TOTO Hong Kong, TOTO, toilet, Washlet, Japan, bidet, global, culture, faucet, bathtub

items.context: Luminist is a unique specialty material of TOTO. It adorns the bathroom area with its modern, elegant, art-like design. With translucent crystal appearance and excellent machinability, LUMINIST can create outstanding aesthetic and practical bathroom products. In addition to withstanding the high temperatures, compared with general glass, LUMINIST is more resistant to knocking, not easy to be scratched and more durable.
